caravans.name: Atlas Oasis
caravans.blurb:
Atlas Oasis 28ft x 10ft — Two Bedroom Holiday Caravan
A bright, well-proportioned two bedroom holiday home offering fantastic value and comfortable family living. Step through the main entrance into a spacious open-plan lounge and dining area, flooded with natural light from the full-width end window.
The U-shaped kitchen is generously fitted with plenty of wall and base cupboards, a stainless steel sink, and a built-in gas cooker — everything you need to cook up a holiday feast. The adjoining lounge features wrap-around seating and a cosy gas fire, perfect for winding down after a day at the beach.
Both bedrooms are well-appointed, with the main double offering fitted wardrobes and bedside storage. The fully enclosed shower room includes a pedestal wash basin, mirror, and separate WC for added convenience.
Ideal as a holiday retreat, a base for family getaways, or a static let — the Oasis 28x10 combines practical living space with a warm, homely feel throughout.
